Chapter 1160 - 23: Overwhelming Might Across Void Domains (Seeking Monthly Tickets At The Beginning Of The Month)

Chapter 1160: Chapter 23: Overwhelming Might Across Void Domains (Seeking Monthly Tickets at the Beginning of the Month)

The blue-gray light tore through time and space, barely escaping from the silent battlefield.

The Chaos Venerables observing from afar had not yet reacted when they heard the voice of the Dual Origin Great Saint rapidly spread through the fluctuations of time and space—

"Galaxy Great Saint, I admit defeat this time. I will leave this universe immediately and swear not to come near for ten Cosmic Eras..."

After the brief encounter with Lin Yuan, the Dual Origin Great Saint had no further desires regarding this Xuanhuang Universe. What did it matter if its creator was an almost Invincible Great Saint?

His Dual Origin was simply no match for Lin Yuan. In front of Lin Yuan, he hardly managed to escape, let alone ensure his survival.

If it wasn’t for Lin Yuan dealing with Black Light and Wild Barbarian, causing the massive suppressive force of time and space around to disperse.

The Dual Origin Great Saint was uncertain whether his desperate activation of the Dual Origin fusion power would have allowed him to escape as he did.

"Is that... the Dual Origin Great Saint?"

"Is the Dual Origin Great Saint admitting defeat?"

"Who is the Galaxy Great Saint?"

"Nonsense, who else could it be? Among the ten Great Saints, except for the mysterious last one to appear, the other nine all have titles. The Galaxy Great Saint... is probably that mysterious Great Saint!"

The Chaos Venerables were instantly in an uproar. According to their speculations, the probability of the Dual Origin Great Saint emerging victorious among the ten Great Saints was high.

After all, this Great Saint’s strength was indeed formidable and was the first to enter the Xuanhuang Universe.

But now?

The Dual Origin Great Saint was the first to escape and admit defeat?

"Galaxy Great Saint... never heard of it?"

"Probably a Great Saint from incredibly ancient times. To force the Dual Origin Great Saint to admit defeat and swear not to approach this universe for ten Cosmic Eras... the Galaxy Great Saint must have the power to slay the Dual Origin Great Saint."

A Chaos Realm peak Venerable concluded.

If the strength was only slightly superior, the Dual Origin Great Saint wouldn’t have been so panic-stricken and swearing to leave immediately.

One must know that the suppressive force of time and space in this Postnatal Universe is so intense; its creator must be extraordinary, even if it means abandoning the treasure that has emerged now.

As long as the Dual Origin Great Saint had a bit of confidence, he would explore other regions.

Swearing to leave directly implies that the Dual Origin Great Saint dares not linger too long.

A slight pause would come at a cost.

"If the Galaxy Great Saint’s strength is so formidable, why didn’t the Dual Origin Great Saint join forces with the other eight Great Saints to resist?" A Chaos Venerable voiced this doubt.

"How do you know they didn’t join forces?" The Chaos Realm peak Venerable who came to a conclusion earlier was shocked, "Maybe the nine Great Saints already tried to join forces, but were still suppressed by the Galaxy Great Saint, and only the Dual Origin Great Saint barely escaped."

The previous silence on the battlefield puzzled him. With ten Great Saints inside, how could there be no sign of any movement?

Now seeing the Dual Origin Great Saint’s hasty escape, this peak Venerable arrived at a deeper conclusion, which was that the Galaxy Great Saint’s strength was overwhelming enough to crush the combined efforts of nine Great Saints.

Because of this, the aftermath of the battle could be easily suppressed, resulting in the outside world seeing an unusually quiet battlefield.

"The Galaxy Great Saint... could it be an Absolute Great Saint?" The Chaos Realm peak Venerable was secretly amazed, as nine Chaos Great Saints joined forces, with three of them being powerful saints like Dual Origin.

Yet, they were swept away by the Galaxy Great Saint, leaving this peak Venerable to speculate whether the Galaxy Great Saint might be an Absolute Great Saint.

...

Outside the Xuanhuang Universe.

The blue-gray light stopped, forming the figure of the Dual Origin Great Saint.

"This Galaxy Great Saint..."

The Dual Origin Great Saint’s expression was filled with fear, and at the same time, seeing Lin Yuan not pursuing, he let out a heavy sigh of relief.

"Fortunately, that treasure held back the Galaxy Great Saint, otherwise, my escape would not have been so easy."

The Dual Origin Great Saint thought inwardly. From his brief encounter, he determined that Lin Yuan’s method of distorting time and space was equally suited for pursuing enemies.

That warped time and space could be compressed to a few hundred light-years to maximize suppression, or instantly expand to millions of light-years to hinder enemy escape.

If Lin Yuan really pursued him, the Dual Origin Great Saint had no confidence in escaping with his life.

"Not a match, I am simply no match. Chaos Great Saint can be so strong?"

The Dual Origin Great Saint steadied himself, starting a review in his heart.

In terms of time-space suppression, the Galaxy Great Saint far exceeded Black Light Great Saint’s black light distortion. Under the cover of that warped space-time, even powerful beings like the Dual Origin Great Saint found it extremely difficult.

Moreover, the Galaxy Great Saint’s attacking abilities were terrifying; just one grasp caused the Black Light Great Saint’s Black Light Domain to collapse directly.

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s formidable physique also weakened rapidly.

With the suppression of twisted time-space and nearly the extreme attack methods of a Chaos Great Saint.

Lin Yuan can easily sweep through strong beings at the level of Chaos Great Saints. These two capabilities complement each other, resulting in combat power far more than simply one plus one equaling two.

In the view of the Dual Origin Great Saint, Lin Yuan has almost no weaknesses.

Perhaps Lin Yuan is not yet an Absolute Great Saint, nor a match for one.

But for Chaos Great Saints like them, Lin Yuan’s oppressive power is indistinguishable from that of an Absolute Great Saint.

Chaos Great Saints, due to the different paths they take, excel in different areas, yet Lin Yuan is nearly perfect. The only thing the Dual Origin Great Saint is unclear about is Lin Yuan’s defense.

Because under the suppression of twisted time-space, the Dual Origin Great Saint couldn’t even get close to Lin Yuan, and all attacks were blocked and dissipated by the vast time-space.
